The '''Sistema de Información de la Población Objetivo''' (SIPO) is a social registry used by the [[Joint Social Welfare Institute]] of Costa Rica to classify the [[Demographics of Costa Rica|population of Costa Rica]] as to levels of [[poverty]] and [[extreme poverty]]. It seeks to ensure that institutional resources effectively reach the most vulnerable groups of [[Costa Rican people|Costa Rican society]].

The registry works as an information tool for communities to develop projects, and, more importantly, enables [[government institution]]s to use it to implement programs to benefit target populations. Information in the registry is obtained from the Social Information Sheet ([[Ficha de Información Social|FIS]]), which contains a set of variables, grouped into 10 sections.
